note: Cities, towns, airports with an IATA code, and archaeological sites AS MAPPED IN OPENSTREETMAP. This is the geographic pattern of what the OSM community has recorded, not an official gazetteer: places are missing, and the set is richer in well-mapped areas. Governorate is computed by point-in-polygon against the bundled boundaries, so a place just offshore may come back unassigned.

coverage_check.note: A fixed list of major Egyptian cities is checked against this gazetteer on every build. Any named below is genuinely missing from OpenStreetMap's place=city|town data at this date — not missing from Egypt. It is published because a gazetteer that hides its gaps invites you to mistake it for complete.

population_note: 94 of 335 settlements carry a population tag in OSM. That tag is community-maintained and often years out of date — it is not a census figure and is shown only where OSM has one.
